data.name: Breath Weapon
data.description: Choose Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire: 1/day gain 15-ft cone or 20-ft line breath weapon (1d6 damage, Reflex save negates, Con-based DC); take again for 30-ft or 50-ft area, half damage on failed save, +1 use/day (multiple times); +1d6 damage (multiple times); cost increased by 1 RP each additional time taken.
